svg.text: Blocking sync (pageable) vs. pinned memory, multi-stream overlap, and Slurm core pinning
Before: Blocking Sync (Pageable Memory + Default Stream 0)
Effective GPU utilization ~33% (serialized waits + pageable copies)
After: Pinned Memory + Multi-Stream Async + Slurm Core Pinning (--cpu-bind=cores)
1. cudaMallocHost pinned memory enables async DMA overlap
2. Three CUDA streams pipeline H2D, Kernel, and D2H stages
